name: Quote
description: One large pull quote from the founder, a maker or the press, with attribution and an optional portrait. For several customer reviews, use Testimonials.

fields.name: Quote
fields.helpText: 1 to 3 sentences, up to about 240 characters. No quotation marks: the icon supplies them.

fields.name: Role
fields.helpText: For example "Founder, Northwind Goods" or "Winter gift guide, 2025".

fields.name: Avatar
fields.helpText: Small round portrait next to the name (either variant). Shows initials when missing.

fields.name: Image
fields.helpText: 4:5 portrait or product photo with a focal point. Only shown in with-image.

fields.name: Source link label
fields.helpText: Accessible name of the link on the role line, e.g. "Read the guide". The visible text stays the role.

fields.name: Source link
fields.helpText: The article or page the role line links to.
